Class Player

java.lang.Object
app.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents the player in the game.

The player has a canvas for displaying the character, a position object for tracking movement, and a stats object for tracking player values.

  • Constructor Details

    • Player

      public Player(javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas canvas)
      Creates a player using the given canvas.

      The player starts at the default position of x = 350 and y = 300, and receives a new PlayerStats object.

      Parameters:
      canvas - the canvas used to display the player
